purpose: Business metrics for AI Monk Database without AI-status UI.

business_metrics.followers: Latest dated single-platform followers/subscribers; no cross-platform sum.
business_metrics.views: Highest observed sampled-video view count, selected platform when known; never channel totals or recent 30-day reach.
business_metrics.revenue: Latest source-linked three-month USD gross revenue. No annualization, currency conversion, price/counter multiplication, profit or buyout substitution.
business_metrics.unknowns: Unknown, not zero; ordered after known zero.

revenue_evidence.basis: Industry profile reports a creator-shared gross-revenue dashboard claim, not independently audited sales.
limits: Not a present monthly revenue estimate.
The $300k profit/earnings and $325k acquisition claims are not revenue comparison values.

design_references.observation: Public crawl returned title only; no private app analytics inspected.
Official product page describes downloads/revenue estimates, platform breakdown and competitor benchmarking; it does not supply AI-monk revenue.
Square screen visually inspected: period filter and separate net-sales/count columns with sorting; borrow explicit metric period.
Calendly screen visually inspected: all-time filter and clearly labelled funnel counts; no revenue success metric asserted.

remaining: Collect fresh dated platform observations and additional source-linked revenue disclosures.
Natural recurring data-update execution not yet verified.
